ravikiran2026.pool_title: When Models Defer to Wrong Answers: A Robustness Audit of Source-Attributed Cues in Multiple-Choice QA
ravikiran2026.title: When Models Defer to Wrong Answers: A Robustness Audit of Source-Attributed Cues in Multiple-Choice QA

rose2019.difference: Zero trust architecture: no implicit trust from network position; the architectural claim that every step must be verified, whose value this study asks about.
rose2019.title: Zero Trust Architecture

sadowski2018.difference: Describes modern code review as practised at Google, including reviewer assignment and tooling; a large deployed review process whose benefit is reported as practice.
sadowski2018.title: Modern Code Review

safin2026.difference: Studies trust propagation and structural containment in multi-agent pipelines, where a low-privilege agent can influence a high-privilege one; influence propagation across agents is a different channel from the fidelity with which one approval denotes its action.
safin2026.pool_title: Trust propagation and structural containment in Multi-agent LLM pipelines
safin2026.title: Trust Propagation and Structural Containment in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines

santonidesio2018.authors: Santoni de Sio, F., van den Hoven, J.
santonidesio2018.difference: A philosophical account of meaningful human control over autonomous systems; a criterion for when control is meaningful, which this study replaces with a quantity that can be computed.
santonidesio2018.pool_title: Meaningful Human Control over Autonomous Systems: A Philosophical Account
santonidesio2018.title: Meaningful Human Control over Autonomous Systems: A Philosophical Account

schwarz2025.difference: Layers several defences for LLM applications against prompt injection and related attacks; layering reduces attack success, and this study asks whether the human layer pays.
schwarz2025.pool_title: Countermind: A Multi-Layered Security Architecture for Large Language Models
schwarz2025.title: Countermind: A Multi-Layered Security Architecture for Large Language Models

shamis2025.authors: Shamis, A., Stephenson, M., Zhou, L.
shamis2025.difference: Prices execution assurance for data-centre workloads in a BFT setting; pricing assurance is the closest economics to this study, but the priced resource is hardware-backed execution, not a human decision with a mismatch channel.
shamis2025.pool_title: TEE-BFT: Pricing the Security of Data Center Execution Assurance
shamis2025.title: TEE-BFT: Pricing the Security of Data Center Execution Assurance

shraga2026.authors: Shraga, I., Eshel, R., Gorelik, L.
shraga2026.difference: Shows an LLM guardrail can approve correctly at check time and be stale by act time; staleness is the time axis of the same defect this study writes as a substitution channel, and it measures staleness rather than the value of the gate that suffers it.
shraga2026.pool_title: Approved Too Late: Verdict Staleness in LLM-Guarded Self-Adaptive Systems
shraga2026.title: Approved Too Late: Verdict Staleness in LLM-Guarded Self-Adaptive Systems

singh2026.difference: Shows deepfake detectors learn some attack families less well than others; uneven detection across attack families is the same shape as a reviewer's effective sensitivity falling below its nominal one.
singh2026.pool_title: Not All Attacks Are Learned Equally in Speech Deepfake Detection
singh2026.title: Not All Attacks Are Learned Equally in Speech Deepfake Detection

sohail2026.difference: Characterises centralization and observability of the remote MCP ecosystem by measurement; observability of a tool transport is a different object from the fidelity of the artifact a reviewer is shown.
sohail2026.pool_title: Characterizing Network Centralization and Observability in the Remote MCP Ecosystem
sohail2026.title: Characterizing Network Centralization and Observability in the Remote MCP Ecosystem

sotoudeh2025.difference: Formally verifies a software fault isolation system, including its verifier; a verifier proved correct is a different claim from a reviewer shown a faithful object.
sotoudeh2025.pool_title: Automated Formal Verification of a Software Fault Isolation System
sotoudeh2025.title: Automated Formal Verification of a Software Fault Isolation System

strong2026.difference: Estimates whether a model should act or defer to a human expert, and adapts deferral across experts; the deferral rule is the same structure as this study's escalation coverage, with the channel's fidelity held fixed and no harm term from an unfaithful review.
strong2026.pool_title: RACER: Role-Aligned Competence Estimation for Human-AI Routing
strong2026.title: RACER: Role-Aligned Competence Estimation for Human-AI Routing

sun2026.difference: Measures constraint weakening across 1,296 controlled episodes, where a normal handoff transform deactivates binding state in 100.0% of them and 54.2% of downstream executions perform a forbidden action; it measures that fidelity is below 1 in an ordinary pipeline, which this study takes as the low end of its axis rather than as its question.
sun2026.pool_title: When "Must" Becomes "Maybe": Constraint Weakening in LLM Agent Workflows
sun2026.title: When "Must" Becomes "Maybe": Constraint Weakening in LLM Agent Workflows

surapani2026.difference: Surveys authorization architectures for tool-using agents and organises them by where the check sits; it compares architectures as designs, and measures no value for a gate, so the fidelity at which a gate's value turns negative is not a quantity in it.
surapani2026.pool_title: Authorization Architectures for Tool-Using AI Agents
surapani2026.title: Authorization Architectures for Tool-Using AI Agents

swets1973.difference: The relative operating characteristic in psychology; the origin of the signal-detection reading of a human decision that this study imports into an approval gate.
swets1973.pool_title: The Relative Operating Characteristic in Psychology
swets1973.title: The Relative Operating Characteristic in Psychology

szabadvary2025.difference: Gives distribution-free error guarantees for classification with a reject option via conformal prediction; the guarantee is about the abstention rate, not about the net value of the escalated cases, which is what this study computes.
szabadvary2025.pool_title: Classification with Reject Option: Distribution-free Error Guarantees via Conformal Prediction
szabadvary2025.title: Classification with Reject Option: Distribution-Free Error Guarantees via Conformal Prediction

thompson2007.difference: Reflections on trusting trust: trust in a chain is trust in whatever wrote it; the reason an approval artifact's provenance matters independently of its content.
thompson2007.title: Reflections on Trusting Trust

townsend1979.difference: Optimal contracts with costly state verification; verification is itself costly and is used only when it pays, which is the decision rule this study derives for a human gate.
townsend1979.pool_title: Optimal Contracts and Competitive Markets With Costly State Verification
townsend1979.title: Optimal Contracts and Competitive Markets with Costly State Verification

turan2026.difference: Calibrates agent guards to a subjective, fatiguing human and shows oversight has a capacity; it prices the reviewer's capacity, and our model keeps the reviewer fixed and varies the channel's fidelity, so the two are complementary inputs to one value.
turan2026.pool_title: Oversight Has a Capacity: Calibrating Agent Guards to a Subjective, Fatiguing Human
turan2026.title: Oversight Has a Capacity: Calibrating Agent Guards to a Subjective, Fatiguing Human

udayagiri2026.difference: Gates a call to an LLM on confidence to control cost in emotion recognition; a confidence gate trades accuracy against cost, and this study's gate trades harm against the harm an unfaithful review can authorise.
udayagiri2026.pool_title: When to Call an LLM: A Confidence-Gated Hybrid for Cost-Effective Emotion Recognition in Conversational AI
udayagiri2026.title: When to Call an LLM: A Confidence-Gated Hybrid for Cost-Effective Emotion Recognition in Conversational AI

vallabhaneni2026.authors: Vallabhaneni, U., Cagwin, C., Wild, D.
vallabhaneni2026.difference: Offloads topological reasoning from LLM agents in a security operations centre, where analyst escalation is a routine step; escalation volume is treated as load to reduce rather than as a cost term that can exceed the harm a gate prevents.
vallabhaneni2026.pool_title: SENTINEL-RL: Offloading Topological Reasoning from LLM Agents in the Security Operations Center
vallabhaneni2026.title: SENTINEL-RL: Offloading Topological Reasoning from LLM Agents in the Security Operations Center

vandersijs2006.authors: van der Sijs, H. et al.
vandersijs2006.difference: Documents how often clinicians override drug-safety alerts and why; the reviewer disagreeing with the checker, measured in deployment rather than derived from a channel.
vandersijs2006.pool_title: Overriding of Drug Safety Alerts in Computerized Physician Order Entry
vandersijs2006.title: Overriding of Drug Safety Alerts in Computerized Physician Order Entry

veski2026.authors: Veski, R., Guerraoui, R., Froelicher, D.
veski2026.difference: Delegates privileges among collaborating agents with a capability-based scheme; delegation governs who may act, while the question here is whether the object presented for review denotes the action taken.
veski2026.pool_title: CAPMAS: Capability-Based Delegation of Privileges in Multi-Agent Systems
veski2026.title: CAPMAS: Capability-Based Delegation of Privileges in Multi-Agent Systems

wang2026.authors: Wang, P., Li, Y., Tian, Y.
wang2026.difference: Reframes agent security as an agent-human interaction problem and reports, from a survey of production systems, that runtime approval is deployed while no criterion for when a gate pays exists; it names the deployment and leaves the criterion open, which is this study's question.
wang2026.pool_title: Reframing LLM Agent Security as an Agent-Human Interaction Problem
wang2026.title: Reframing LLM Agent Security as an Agent-Human Interaction Problem

wang2026a.difference: Audits candidate actions before execution to block indirect-injection consequences; a pre-execution audit is a programmatic check, which is one of the repairs this study prices against a reviewer-mediated one.
wang2026a.pool_title: ActGuard: Pre-execution Action Auditing against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
wang2026a.title: ActGuard: Pre-Execution Action Auditing Against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM Agents

weingart2003.difference: Reports physicians' decisions to override computerised drug alerts in primary care; override behaviour is the human step's cost side, measured with no artifact-fidelity axis.
weingart2003.pool_title: Physicians' Decisions to Override Computerized Drug Alerts in Primary Care
weingart2003.title: Physicians' Decisions to Override Computerized Drug Alerts in Primary Care

williamson1986.difference: Costly monitoring and equilibrium credit rationing; monitoring is costly and worth only the difference it makes, the economic structure this study instantiates with a fidelity parameter.
williamson1986.pool_title: Costly monitoring, financial intermediation, and equilibrium credit rationing
williamson1986.title: Costly Monitoring, Financial Intermediation, and Equilibrium Credit Rationing

wu2026.difference: Delivers prompt-space security skills to coding agents so that privilege use is mediated; it mediates the agent's own requests, while this study asks when a human-mediated mediation step has positive expected value.
wu2026.pool_title: SkillShield: Prompt-Space Security Skills for LLM Coding Agents
wu2026.title: SkillShield: Prompt-Space Security Skills for LLM Coding Agents

xiong2026.difference: Confines reachable capabilities for LLM agents under indirect injection, at the level of what a compromised agent can reach; capability reach is a bound on harm, and the value of an approval gate is a different quantity, which this study makes depend on fidelity.
xiong2026.pool_title: Reachability-Based Capability Confinement for LLM Agents under Indirect Prompt Injection
xiong2026.title: Reachability-Based Capability Confinement for LLM Agents under Indirect Prompt Injection

youden1950.difference: Youden's index for rating diagnostic tests; a one-number summary of a detector's operating point, used here as a reviewer-accuracy summary rather than as a value.
youden1950.title: Index for Rating Diagnostic Tests

zaoui2025.difference: Extends selective prediction to distributional regression with a reject option; abstention is placed on a distributional target, and no channel between the reviewer and the executed object appears.
zaoui2025.title: Distributional Regression with Reject Option

zhang2026.authors: Zhang, Y., Huang, J., Gu, G.
zhang2026.difference: Separates trust boundaries with provenance-aware transformers; provenance is a property the model is trained to use, while this study treats the reviewer's information as a channel whose fidelity is an experimental axis.
zhang2026.pool_title: Origin Is All You Need: Provenance-Aware Transformers for Structural Trust-Boundary Separation
zhang2026.title: Origin Is All You Need: Provenance-Aware Transformers for Structural Trust-Boundary Separation

zhang2026a.difference: Estimates confidence from experience so that a system can defer reliably; calibration of a self-report is a different object from the fidelity with which an approval denotes an action, and this study varies the latter.
zhang2026a.pool_title: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents
zhang2026a.title: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents

zhang2026b.difference: Bounds the recall of a fixed-invariant FSA monitor by the entropy of the attack distribution; that is the adjacent monitor law for a programmatic detector, and no analogous bound is published for a human gate, which is what this study supplies.
zhang2026b.pool_title: Why Formal Monitors Fail: Attack Distribution Entropy as a Coverage Bound for LTL-Based LLM Agent Safety
zhang2026b.title: Why Formal Monitors Fail: Attack Distribution Entropy as a Coverage Bound for LTL-Based LLM Agent Safety

zheng2026.authors: Zheng, Y., Zhang, W., Mao, Y.
zheng2026.difference: Argues agent capabilities should follow task intent and the source of context, so that authority tracks provenance; the argument is normative, and the value of the approval step it implies is what this study measures.
zheng2026.pool_title: LLM Agent Capabilities Should Follow Task Intent and Context Source
zheng2026.title: LLM Agent Capabilities Should Follow Task Intent and Context Source

zhu2026.difference: Governs authority an agent acquires at runtime, for resources such as credentials and accounts; acquired authority is a flow the policy must contain, and it is orthogonal to the fidelity of an approval artifact.
zhu2026.pool_title: Runtime Authorization for Resources Acquired by AI Agents
zhu2026.title: Runtime Authorization for Resources Acquired by AI Agents

zhu2026a.difference: Binds a dependency closure and governs effects at operation time for agent skills; effect governance is a check on the operation, which is the repair axis this study prices.
zhu2026a.pool_title: Versioned Transitive Dependency-Closure Binding and Operation-Time Effect Governance for Agent Skills: ClosureBound
zhu2026a.title: Versioned Transitive Dependency-Closure Binding and Operation-Time Effect Governance for Agent Skills: ClosureBound
